## Key Proprietary Software Products
1. **ShowForm.app** (https://showform.app)
   - *Type*: Shopify App / SaaS Form Builder
   - *Description*: Zero-code Shopify-native form builder enabling merchants to create custom forms, multi-step capture forms, and lead generation workflows without code.
2. **SpotMetal** (https://apps.shopify.com/spotmetal-pricing-buyback)
   - *Type*: Shopify Data & Pricing Engine
   - *Description*: Real-time precious metals pricing engine for Shopify stores selling gold, silver, and bullion with dynamic live exchange rate banners and automatic spread calculations.
3. **AutoGaragePro** (https://autogaragepro.com)
   - *Type*: Operations SaaS
   - *Description*: Workshop management platform for automotive garages managing customer vehicles, job cards, parts inventory, and automated billing.
